about: reelkit.audio generators (48,000 Hz, float64): each at its default arguments and at each argument set the flute_vs_trombone soundtrack uses

notes.args: the call's arguments with the defaults filled in; floats as float.hex()
notes.nested: how many of those calls came from inside another generator (chime calls expenv)
notes.reverb: reverb(x, ...) on stand-in buffers: `impulse` (a 1 s stereo buffer whose first row is 1, 1: the output is the first second of the impulse response itself, as fftconvolve returns it) and `burst` (0.25 s of stereo noise). The episode calls it once, on the whole send
notes.seeds: thud is called with 229 argument sets that differ mostly in `seed`: for each (dur, f0, f1) the first 2 seeds used have vectors, and episode_calls lists them all
notes.tape_stop: tape_stop(x, t0, length) on the stand-in buffer `tape` with t0 = 0.05 s (the episode stops three buses at the K.O. time; only int(t0 * 48000) depends on it)
notes.uses: how many times the soundtrack build made the call (0 for a default the episode never uses)
notes.why: "default": the signature's defaults (stand_in lists the values given to arguments that have none); "episode": an argument set kit.music.main() used
